tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: This prayer, “Tiferet baḥurim (The Glory of Young Men)” by Pinḥas Barukh Monselice is found in a manuscript, Oxford, Bodleian Library Ms. 1418 Regg. 33 (Ferrara, from the second half of the 17th century). A transcription was first made and published as: Pinchas Monselice, Tif’eret baḥurim: Madrikh ha-ḥatanim ha-Yehudi ha-rishon (Glory of Young Men: The First Jewish Guide-book for Weddings), ed. Roni Weinstein (Jerusalem: Ben Zvi Institute, 2010), pp. 260–261. The English translation here is based upon that first made by Jeffrey M. Green and published at the Posen Library (in The Posen Library of Jewish Culture and Civilization, vol. 5). (Thank you!) A few small modifications have been made, mainly to the re-Hebraicization of divine names, the inclusion of several notes found in the published transcription, and to the translation of “shedin” and “lilin.” Where verses were cited with ובו׳, I have added the full verse. –Aharon Varady
